About this item

  • MADE FOR SHOP WINDOWS: A 3,500-nit panel stays readable through glass in direct daylight, with automatic brightness that adjusts through the day.
  • BUILT TO RUN 24/7: Designed for unattended commercial use, with remote monitoring, automatic crash recovery and OTA updates.
  • OPEN ANDROID 14 PLATFORM: RK3576 octa-core processor with 4 GB + 32 GB. Play from USB, the network or your own signage CMS.
  • INSTALL IT YOUR WAY: 47 mm slim chassis and five mounting options including wall, suspended and floor stand, in landscape or portrait.
  • SIX SIZES, ONE STANDARD: 32", 43", 49", 55", 65" and 75", all on the same platform. Supported by AIOLEC's UK team, with installation quoted on request.
